The main takeaway from our work is that

the expression of CYP2B6, CYP3B4, CYP2C9, CYP3C19, CYPD2B6 and MDR1 genotypes in peripheral blood of liver graft recipients may be different from those of liver grafts, and the expression of the final genotypes in liver tissue depends on the donor.
